purpose: Evidence and editorial briefs for parent integration; not final publishable Markdown
inventoryMethod: Existing published Markdown filenames/frontmatter and closest reader intent reviewed; draft-only files not proposed as existing public URLs.
editorialRules: Source facts are centralized below; section points are original editorial recommendations unless a source is explicitly cited.
Do not state personal travel experience. Suggested time blocks/routes are editorial drafts until mapped or tested.
Exact current rail policies remain gated by full primary-source access; search snippets are leads, not complete verification.
No image license or geographic coordinates have been verified in this research. Use address text and map-query links pending coordinate validation.
Sources being official does not grant commercial photo reuse; obtain asset-level license and attribution before downloading/publishing.
Dates, tariffs, temporary opening hours and entry policies must retain checked date and a current official link; never describe them as live.
criticalFindings: Climate Card 30-day prepaid product has ended recharge; short-term passes continue. Inbound boarding at Incheon remains excluded.
2026 rail changes make old separate-app/one-month booking advice unsafe; exact new rules require full official verification.
Family room name does not establish guest capacity or extra bed; two direct hotel pages prove room-specific variation.
Current Suwon Korean operator differs from older English winter hours; 2026 night season ends Nov1.
Seoul Forest main park hours do not apply to specialist gardens/fountains; winter schedule differs.

sources.title: Seoul Metropolitan Government: Climate Card
verifiedClaims: 30-day prepaid recharges ended 2026-08-31; 1/2/3/5/7-day short-term products remain.
Short-term prices KRW 5,000/8,000/10,000/15,000/20,000; physical card KRW 3,000 separately.
Recharge date is start date; no advance recharge. Validity follows service days rather than rolling 24-hour periods.
Coverage excludes Sinbundang, GTX, express/airport buses and other-region licensed buses; verify station-specific exceptions.
Airport T1/T2 permit alighting only, not boarding. Seoul-licensed buses may run beyond city boundaries.

sections.heading: Start with the trip you can actually fit

sections.heading: Choose a base from your real arrival route
points: Compare hotel door-to-station access, lift/stairs and the final walk with luggage, not only station names.

points: Make the only fixed arrival-day tasks immigration, connectivity if needed, transport, check-in and a meal near the hotel.
